extracted.intended_audience: travelers, artists, architects, and readers of art criticism (students/practitioners interested in Venetian architecture and ornament)
extracted.subtask_description: Extracts of John Ruskin's evaluative statements about architecture, ornament, sculpture, painting, and related artistic/practical principles as guidance for judging and producing art and buildings, with particular attention to Venetian examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abacus
rubrics_metrics.description: defined; law of its proportion; its connection with cornices; its various profiles
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pages referenced: i.114; proportions discussed i.117-122; consider relationship to cornices (i.123) and profile choices (i.312-315; iii.244-245).

rubrics_metrics.name: Acanthus (leaf)
rubrics_metrics.description: its use in architecture; how treated at Torcello
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use of acanthus leaf as an architectural ornament and regional treatments (Torcello) noted as points of comparative judgment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alabaster
rubrics_metrics.description: use of, in incrustation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider alabaster's suitability and aesthetic effect when used in inlaid/incrusted surfaces (ii.89).

rubrics_metrics.name: Anachronism
rubrics_metrics.description: necessity of, in the best art
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ruskin asserts that tasteful anachronism can be necessary in superior works of art (ii.198).

rubrics_metrics.name: Anatomy (study for artists)
rubrics_metrics.description: a disadvantageous study for artists
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Warning against overvaluing anatomical study at the expense of other artistic faculties (iii.50).

rubrics_metrics.name: Angels (in heraldry and sculpture)
rubrics_metrics.description: use of their images in Venetian heraldry; statues on the Ducal Palace
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider symbolic program and placement (ii.276; ii.309) when judging figural ornament.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anger (symbolization)
rubrics_metrics.description: how symbolically represented
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Study conventions of symbolic representation in sculpture and ornament (ii.342).

rubrics_metrics.name: Angles (decoration)
rubrics_metrics.description: decoration of angles; of Gothic palaces; of Ducal Palace
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examine how corner treatments contribute to overall composition (i.258; ii.303; ii.238; ii.305).

rubrics_metrics.name: Animal character in ornament
rubrics_metrics.description: animal character in northern and southern climates; in grotesque art
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess climatic and cultural influences on animal depiction and grotesque ornament (ii.156-8; iii.149).

rubrics_metrics.name: Apertures (openings)
rubrics_metrics.description: analysis of their structure; general forms of apertures
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate openings (windows/doors) by structural analysis and typology (i.62; i.176).

rubrics_metrics.name: Apse (forms)
rubrics_metrics.description: forms of apse in southern and northern churches compared; of Murano
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compare regional apse forms for ecclesiastical fitness and stylistic appropriateness (i.173; ii.380).

rubrics_metrics.name: Arabesques of Kaifaelle
rubrics_metrics.description: their baseness
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Critical judgment: some arabesques are treated as inferior or base design (iii.136).

rubrics_metrics.name: Arabian architecture
rubrics_metrics.description: coverage of Arabian architecture and its qualities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include consideration of style, ornament, and influence when comparing architectures (i.30,234,235,425; ii.137).

rubrics_metrics.name: Arches
rubrics_metrics.description: general structure of; moral characters; lancet/round/depressed/four-centred/ogee/non-concentric; masonry; load; not derived from vegetation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess arches by structural form, material/masonry, proportion, and intended moral/expressive character; beware of false botanical origin theories (i.128-149; i.135-138; ii.217; ii.201).

rubrics_metrics.name: Architects (modern)
rubrics_metrics.description: their unfortunate position
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider social/institutional constraints on contemporary architects when evaluating modern work (i.399,402).

rubrics_metrics.name: Architecture (general)
rubrics_metrics.description: general view of its divisions; how to judge of it; adaptation to requirements of human mind; richness of early domestic; manner of its debasement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge architecture by clarity of division, human adaptation, domestic richness, and susceptibility to debasement; reference ii.174 and iii.192, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Archivolts
rubrics_metrics.description: decoration of; general families; profiles; examples (Murano, St. Mark's, London, Byzantine)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate archivolt treatment by family/type and profile; regional comparisons given (i.327-328; ii.54; iii.245).

rubrics_metrics.name: Arts (relative dignity and classification)
rubrics_metrics.description: relative dignity of the arts; relation to materials; division into art of facts, of design, and of both; purist/naturalist/sensualist; art opposed to inspiration; definition and enjoyment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When assessing art, consider its dignity, material relations, classificatory type, relation to inspiration, and appropriate modes of enjoyment (i.389; ii.183-187; iii.151,170,188).

rubrics_metrics.name: Aspiration in Gothic
rubrics_metrics.description: not the primal motive of Gothic work
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not overread vertical aspiration as primary Gothic motive; consider other elements (i.155).

rubrics_metrics.name: Astrology (representation)
rubrics_metrics.description: judicial astrology representation in Venetian sculpture
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess symbolic programs that include astrological imagery for meaning and cultural appropriateness (ii.350).

rubrics_metrics.name: Backgrounds (diapered)
rubrics_metrics.description: diapered backgrounds
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider patterned backgrounds as a compositional device in ornament and painting (iii.24).

rubrics_metrics.name: Balconies
rubrics_metrics.description: of Venice; general treatment; of iron
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate balcony design for material, proportion, and relation to façade (ii.243; iii.256; ii.247).

rubrics_metrics.name: Bases
rubrics_metrics.description: general account; of walls, piers, shafts; decoration; faults of Gothic profiles; should not be richly decorated; general effect
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge bases for proportion, appropriate ornamentation level (avoid excess), family/type, and their contribution to overall massing (i.63-64; i.88; i.277-288; ii.386).

rubrics_metrics.name: Battlements
rubrics_metrics.description: use and abuse in ornamentation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess battlements for functional truth and ornamental use; beware of decorative abuse (i.166; i.219).

rubrics_metrics.name: Beauty and ornament
rubrics_metrics.description: relation of the terms
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Understand how ornament contributes to perceived beauty; evaluate ornament's role rather than as mere decoration (i.399).

rubrics_metrics.name: Birds in ornament
rubrics_metrics.description: use of birds in ornamentation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider appropriateness and symbolism of avian motifs (i.233; ii.141).

rubrics_metrics.name: Brackets
rubrics_metrics.description: division of; ridiculous forms
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classify bracket types and avoid absurd/ridiculous shapes; study proper division (i.165).

rubrics_metrics.name: Breadth in Byzantine design
rubrics_metrics.description: breadth as a quality in Byzantine composition
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Look for compositional breadth and open massing in Byzantine examples (ii.135).

rubrics_metrics.name: Brickwork (ornamental)
rubrics_metrics.description: ornamental brickwork; general considerations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess patterning, bonding, and color in brick ornament (i.291; ii.240,259,260).

rubrics_metrics.name: Buttresses
rubrics_metrics.description: general structure; flying buttress; supposed sanctity
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate buttress forms by structural necessity, expression, and cultural meanings (i.169; i.194; i.176).

rubrics_metrics.name: Byzantine style
rubrics_metrics.description: analysis; ecclesiastical fitness; centralization; palaces; sculpture
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge Byzantine architecture for centralization, ecclesiastical suitability, surface treatment, and sculptural character (ii.78; ii.100; ii.236; ii.120; ii.138).

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitals
rubrics_metrics.description: general structure; bells; just proportions; various families; necessity to shafts in good architecture; Byzantine; Lily; Solomon's temple
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess capitals for proportion, family/type, appropriateness to shaft, and regional/period characteristics (i.112-125; ii.132-139; iii.231-232).

rubrics_metrics.name: Care (symbolism)
rubrics_metrics.description: how care is symbolized; cross-reference to 'Sorrow'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate symbolic programs and conventional personifications (ii.346).

rubrics_metrics.name: Cathedrals (English)
rubrics_metrics.description: effect of English cathedrals
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider monumental effect, interior space, and national character in English cathedral design (ii.67; i.101-194 references).

rubrics_metrics.name: Centralization in design
rubrics_metrics.description: centralization as a compositional principle
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess how central planning or massing affects function and symbolism (ii.236).

rubrics_metrics.name: Changefulness (element of Gothic)
rubrics_metrics.description: changefulness as a Gothic quality
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Look for variety and change as positive Gothic attributes (ii.172).

rubrics_metrics.name: Charity (symbolism)
rubrics_metrics.description: how charity is symbolized
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interpret iconographic programs to understand virtues personified in architectural sculpture (ii.321,325,337).

rubrics_metrics.name: Chastity (symbolism)
rubrics_metrics.description: how chastity is symbolized
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As above for virtue personification (ii.326).

rubrics_metrics.name: Cheerfulness (symbolism and virtue)
rubrics_metrics.description: how symbolized; virtue of cheerfulness
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess representations of mood/virtue in ornament and their moral readings (iii.128; ii.324,346).

rubrics_metrics.name: Christianity (influence on art)
rubrics_metrics.description: how mingled with worldliness; how imperfectly understood; influence on liberating workmen and on forms
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate religious context and influence on craftsmanship, iconography, and form (iii.108-110; i.242; ii.159; i.107).

rubrics_metrics.name: Church decoration (extent allowable)
rubrics_metrics.description: decoration of churches — how far allowable
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider ecclesiastical fitness and appropriateness of ornament within churches (ii.104).

rubrics_metrics.name: Civilization (danger/progress)
rubrics_metrics.description: progress of civilization; two-fold danger of
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place architectural changes within broader civilizational contexts and moral consequences (iii.168-169).

rubrics_metrics.name: Color
rubrics_metrics.description: importance in early work; its spirituality; relation to music; quartering; how excusing realization
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat color as structural and spiritual element; study its historic uses and analogies to music; allow color to justify certain realist departures (ii.43-44,81,93; iii.23-24,185,395).

rubrics_metrics.name: Composition
rubrics_metrics.description: definition of the term and compositional judgment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess balance, unity, and ordering principles in design (ii.182).

rubrics_metrics.name: Construction (architectural)
rubrics_metrics.description: how admirable construction is
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value honest, expressive construction as an architectural virtue (i.48).

rubrics_metrics.name: Convenience (Gothic)
rubrics_metrics.description: how convenience is consulted by Gothic architecture
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge Gothic by practical accommodation of use as well as aesthetic form (ii.178-179).

rubrics_metrics.name: Cornices
rubrics_metrics.description: general divisions; of walls and roofs; ornamentation; curvatures; military and Greek cornices
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate cornices by typology, curvature, ornament, and relationship to wall/roof; consult proportions and profiles (i.72-73; i.158; i.299-301; i.160).

rubrics_metrics.name: Cusps
rubrics_metrics.description: definition; groups; relation to vegetation; general treatment; earliest occurrence
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Study cusp morphology, groupings, and ornamental relation to plant forms (i.140-143; ii.218-220; iii.258).

rubrics_metrics.name: Denition of Decoration/Ornament
rubrics_metrics.description: true nature of decoration; how to judge of it; see 'Ornament'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Understand decoration as an expressive, not superficial, element—evaluate its material, limitation, and role in design (i.400; i.56-57).

rubrics_metrics.name: Design (definition and relation to naturalism)
rubrics_metrics.description: definition of term; relations to naturalism
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguish design principles from mere naturalistic imitation and judge composition accordingly (ii.183-196).

rubrics_metrics.name: Division of labour
rubrics_metrics.description: evils of division of labour
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider social effects of labor specialization on workmanship and art quality (ii.165).

rubrics_metrics.name: Doge of Venice (power)
rubrics_metrics.description: his power and civic symbolism
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Take political context into account when reading civic architecture and sculptural programs (i.17,352).

rubrics_metrics.name: Dolphins (symbolism)
rubrics_metrics.description: moral disposition of dolphins; use in representing sea
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess animal motifs for symbolic conventions and coherence with subject (i.229; i.417-418).

rubrics_metrics.name: Domestic architecture (medieval richness)
rubrics_metrics.description: richness of early domestic architecture in middle ages
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value domestic ornament and detail as essential to medieval architectural quality (ii.101; iii.5-6).

rubrics_metrics.name: Doors
rubrics_metrics.description: general structure; smallness in English cathedrals; ancient Venetian doors
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge doors by scale, proportion, and historic typology (i.178-180; ii.276; iii.228).

rubrics_metrics.name: Doric architecture
rubrics_metrics.description: Doric, Christian Doric characteristics and critiques
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate Doric order variants for appropriateness and historical truth (i.160; 296,302,309).

rubrics_metrics.name: Dreams and the Grotesque
rubrics_metrics.description: highest arts resemble dreams; prophetic dreams related to Grotesque
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interpret Grotesque and visionary imagery with attention to imaginative and prophetic qualities (iii.153-156).

rubrics_metrics.name: Dress (ornamentation)
rubrics_metrics.description: its use in ornamentation; dignity of dress; changes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider costume elements as sources for sculptural and painted ornament and their historical meaning (i.212; ii.381; iii.190-192).

rubrics_metrics.name: Duties of buildings
rubrics_metrics.description: architectural duties and functions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess architecture by its obligations of use, beauty, and moral expression (i.59).

rubrics_metrics.name: Education (artists & workmen)
rubrics_metrics.description: evils of university/modern education for workmen; how to educate successfully; education ought to be universal
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Critique formal education that disconnects practice from skill; recommend universal, practical education for artists and craftsmen (i.386; ii.109; ii.165; iii.111-112,215,220-221).

rubrics_metrics.name: Encrusted architecture
rubrics_metrics.description: analysis of encrusted style and its laws
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Study the inlay/incrustation methods and their structural/ornamental rules (i.268-269; ii.79).

rubrics_metrics.name: Finish in workmanship
rubrics_metrics.description: when to require finish; dangers of finish
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demand finish where appropriate but beware overfinishing which can harm vitality (ii.166; iii.163-170).

rubrics_metrics.name: Finials
rubrics_metrics.description: their use in ornamentation; a sign of decline in Venetian architecture
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess terminal ornament (finials) for historic appropriateness; excessive finials may signal stylistic decline (i.339; iii.13).

rubrics_metrics.name: Flowers (representation)
rubrics_metrics.description: representation desirable; how represented in mosaic
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate floral motifs for fidelity, stylization, and appropriate medium treatment (i.231; iii.179).

rubrics_metrics.name: Foliage
rubrics_metrics.description: how carved in declining periods
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Read the quality of carved foliage as an index of artistic health or decay (iii.12,20).

rubrics_metrics.name: Form of Gothic
rubrics_metrics.description: definition and analysis of Gothic form
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguish Gothic formal characteristics (ii.208; ii.152-227) and assess authenticity and structural logic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grotesque (analysis)
rubrics_metrics.description: analysis of Grotesque; changes of form; symbolical character; role in Renaissance work
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate grotesque for its satire, symbolic content, playfulness, and historical shifts (iii.132-162; iii.113-144).

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitation of ornament
rubrics_metrics.description: necessity and principles of limiting ornament
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ornament must be restrained within limits (i.253); judge quantity and subordination of ornament (i.239,400).

rubrics_metrics.name: Lines (abstract use)
rubrics_metrics.description: abstract use of line in ornament
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess how line functions compositionally as a primary design element (i.221).

rubrics_metrics.name: Masonry
rubrics_metrics.description: masonry of walls and arches; types (Mont-Cenisian)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate masonry workmanship, bonding, and truth to material (i.71; i.138; i.138 references).

rubrics_metrics.name: Materials (invention and use)
rubrics_metrics.description: invention of new materials injurious to art; relation of arts to their materials
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer appropriate traditional materials; new materials must be judged for their effect on honesty and expression (ii.393; iii.46).

rubrics_metrics.name: Mosaics
rubrics_metrics.description: character of early mosaics; examples at Torcello and St. Mark's
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess mosaics by color, iconography, and early character (ii.23-24; ii.73,114; iii.174,177).

rubrics_metrics.name: Naturalism
rubrics_metrics.description: analysis with respect to art; its advance in Gothic art; presence/absence in encrusted styles; noble Grotesque
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Weigh naturalism's role against design and ornament; judge presence in different styles (ii.181-196; iii.11,144).

rubrics_metrics.name: Niches
rubrics_metrics.description: use in Northern Gothic and Venetian; French and Veronese examples
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess niches for rhythm, scale, and appropriateness to façade and sculpture (i.275; ii.239; ii.227).

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty
rubrics_metrics.description: necessity to the human mind
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider novelty as a legitimate human demand but balance it with tradition (ii.177).

rubrics_metrics.name: Ornament
rubrics_metrics.description: material of ornament; the best expresses man's delight in God's work, not his own; divided into servile, subordinate, and insubordinate; distant effect; arborescent; restrained within limits; necessarily imperfect; cannot be overcharged if good; quantity regulation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Major rubric: judge ornament by material truth, moral source (delight in nature/God), classification (servile/subordinate/insubordinate), composition at distance, restraint and subordination, acceptance of imperfection, and appropriate quantity (i.211-241; i.247-253; i.400; ii.159).

rubrics_metrics.name: Painters (what they should know and do)
rubrics_metrics.description: power of perception; influence of society; what they should know; what is their business; how to judge of pictures; neglect of pictures in Venice; how far pictures aid religion
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate painters by perceptive power, moral purpose, technical knowledge, and social role; judging pictures requires knowledge of history, condition, and context (ii.369-370; iii.44; ii.106-113; iii.187).

rubrics_metrics.name: Perspective
rubrics_metrics.description: aerial perspective exaggerations; absence in great works; historical pride in perspective
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Don't overvalue aerial perspective; recognize its limits and the fact that many great works lack it (iii.48-60).

rubrics_metrics.name: Perfection (inordinate desire)
rubrics_metrics.description: inordinate desire of perfection destructive of art
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beware perfectionism that kills spontaneity and vitality (i.236; iii.135; iii.167-171).

rubrics_metrics.name: Proportions
rubrics_metrics.description: subtlety of proportions in early work; just proportions of capitals; subtle proportional laws elsewhere
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess the subtle proportional relationships in historical works — proportions are a measure of quality (ii.42,122,128; i.120-125).

rubrics_metrics.name: Quantity of ornament
rubrics_metrics.description: its regulation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regulate amount of ornament by rules of limitation, subordination, and distant effect; good ornament may be abundant if well designed (i.400; i.401; i.239).

rubrics_metrics.name: Renaissance architecture
rubrics_metrics.description: nature of; early, Byzantine, Roman, Grotesque, inconsistencies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge Renaissance works for coherence, honesty, and mixture of motifs; be aware of inconsistencies and debasements (iii.36; iii.5; iii.19; iii.35; iii.113; iii.45).

rubrics_metrics.name: Restraint (ornamental)
rubrics_metrics.description: ornamental restraint is valuable
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value restraint as an aesthetic principle that prevents excess and preserves clarity (i.254).

rubrics_metrics.name: Symbolism (and personification)
rubrics_metrics.description: symboHsm and how opposed to personification; evils of personification
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer symbolic representation that is appropriate and intelligible; caution against crude personification (i.412; ii.321).

rubrics_metrics.name: Tracery
rubrics_metrics.description: structure; flamboyant, stump, English perpendicular; character and strength in Venetian Gothic; forms of tracery bars
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate tracery by its structural logic, bar forms, strength, and stylistic type (i.186-192; ii.219-227; ii.234; iii.253-256).

rubrics_metrics.name: Tombs
rubrics_metrics.description: tombs at Verona, Venice; early Christian, Gothic, Renaissance treatments
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess funerary monuments by typology, symbolism, and period-appropriate treatment (ii.72; iii.70-95; i.147,218).

rubrics_metrics.name: Windows
rubrics_metrics.description: general forms; Arabian; square-headed; development in Venice; orders of windows; advisable forms for modern buildings
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge window forms by typology, proportion, historical development, and suitability for modern usage (i.181-183; ii.211,235,248,268).

rubrics_metrics.name: Workmanship (manual labour)
rubrics_metrics.description: ornamental value of manual labour; evils of division; not a degradation; manual labour's dignity
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess craft quality, respect the dignity of manual work, and resist social practices that degrade artisans (i.402; ii.165-169).

rubrics_metrics.name: Traveler's selective attention (Venetian Index preface)
rubrics_metrics.description: advise travellers to see only what is really worth study; avoid second-rate works; focus attention on characteristic examples (Tintoret, Paul Veronese, John Bellini)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical guideline for travelers: concentrate on characteristic masters and important monuments; do not waste limited time on second-rate works. Specific recommendation: focus on Tintoret, Paul Veronese, John Bellini; Tintoret and Bellini must be seen in Venice to be judged (Venetian Index preface).

rubrics_metrics.name: Judgment of pictures (practical notes)
rubrics_metrics.description: pictures are neglected in Venice; how to form judgment; pictures may be injured and difficult to read
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When evaluating paintings, account for conservation condition, context, and rarity; specialized attention required for damaged/neglected works (ii.369-370).
